cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team at Mudita Studios,

Building early stage companies requires a mix of growth strategy, product led experimentation, and scrappy execution. When I read about Mudita Studios and your mission to launch category defining AI native startups from a one hundred twenty five million dollar fund, I knew I had to reach out. As a growth operator who has co-founded an AI venture and scaled zero to one GTM motions, I am eager to help shape and scale your portfolio companies.

In my recent role co-founding Meu Barzin, an AI conversational startup, I owned our product positioning and go to market execution from scratch. I onboarded over two hundred merchant partners, set up our vector database infrastructure, and built automated outreach funnels. When our early funnel data showed a 43.9% drop-off on initial user interactions, I analyzed our interaction logs, fixed latency bottlenecks, and restructured our user journey. That data-first iteration turned our conversion around and increased deep active engagement to 22.3% on a minimal daily budget.

Before that, at Wipro in partnership with Meta, I served as enablement lead driving GTM adoption across a team of over one hundred fifty analysts. I designed onboarding frameworks and prompt playbooks that accelerated daily tool usage by 150%, leading our operation to be recognized as Meta's top global team for AI growth. My academic background in Philosophy at UFPR also gives me a clear framework for customer psychology, positioning, and ethical governance.

I thrive in fast paced, entrepreneurial environments where I can test growth channels, build automation pipelines, and translate GTM strategies into measurable traction alongside CEOs and founders. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my growth, marketing, and product experience can support Mudita Studios and your portfolio ventures. Thank you for your time and consideration, and I look forward to connecting.

Best regards,

Kevin Augusto Vieira
kevin.aug.vieira@gmail.com | +55 41 99694-1615
https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-augusto/

form_answers.question: Why Mudita Studios and why the Growth & GTM Lead role?
form_answers.answer: Mudita Studios is pioneering a superior venture studio model for AI-first startups. As a growth operator who has co-founded an AI startup, built multi-channel GTM motions, and led enablement across 150+ analysts, I am excited to help Mudita's founders validate ideas rapidly, test scrappy growth channels, and scale category-defining companies.

form_answers.question: Describe a growth experiment or PLG motion you built from scratch.
form_answers.answer: At Meu Barzin, I built our 0-to-1 growth engine for an AI venue assistant. I structured a 200+ venue database in Supabase and integrated real-time interaction tracking. When analytics showed a 43.9% first-message drop-off, I ran rapid iterations to optimize latency and prompt flows, driving deep active engagement up to 22.3% on a minimal budget of R$ 10-20/day.

form_answers.question: How do you leverage technical tools and automations in your growth workflow?
form_answers.answer: I use Vibe Coding (Claude Code, Cursor) and automation tools (N8N, webhooks, Python) as a growth enabler. This allows me to set up CRMs, build lead enrichment pipelines, and track funnel metrics in SQL and Power BI fast without waiting for dedicated engineering resources.
